name: Red Lucy
source:
This is the story of a young man and his sister living with his grandfather. Life is simple with no worries but there are still a lot of questions left unanswered. Why does nobody want to talk about their presumed dead parents? Why is the neighbor's wife so friendly? Things are about to take an unexpected turn and secrets will be unearthed for better or worse.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230328105316/https://le-french.itch.io/red-lucy]Itch.io[/url]]
